attack_techniques: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Kernel Modules and Extensions (T1547.006)
attackers_goals: Gain high privileged command execution on the host machine via one of its running containers.
description: A Docker-contained executable from a mounted share was executed on a host. Running a contained executable is highly dangerous and atypical.
investigative_actions: Check what actions were made after the suspicious file execution. Investigate the contained process and its process tree.
name: A contained executable was executed by an unusual process

variations.name: A contained executable was executed by the Linux kernel thread daemon
attack_techniques: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Kernel Modules and Extensions (T1547.006)
variations.description: A contained executable in a cloud machine was executed by the Linux kernel thread daemon. This behavior is suspicious as it may be a result of an attacker attempting to escape from a container, as the kernel thread daemon is usually used to spawn kernel processes only.
variations.attackers_goals: Gain high privileged command execution on the host machine via one of its running containers.
variations.investigative_actions: Check what actions were made after the suspicious file execution. Investigate the contained process and its process tree.
